source: Department of Finance Canada -- Spring Economic Update 2026, Annex 1, Table A1.4 (Capital Investments)
is_forecast_note: is_forecast=0 means actual/history; is_forecast=1 means SEU 2026 projection. FY2024-25 has null value -- no official opex/capex split for pre-framework year.
notes: SEU 2026 Annex 1 Table A1.4 official capital investment series. The total $311.3B DoF capital claim over FY2024-25 to FY2029-30 is contested by PBO (~$217.3B under stricter international-standard definition, a ~$94B gap). See pipeline comment block for PBO reclassification context.
